dashboard.summary:
Quantization Analysis for Legal Aid Document Processing:
- Post-training quantization reduced model size by up to 29.8%.
- Simulated inference speedup reached up to 0.74x on local CPU.
- Both dynamic and static INT8 models drastically lower memory constraints on edge devices.
dashboard.recommendation: Deployment Guidance: For standard consumer laptops used in legal aid field work, INT8 Dynamic Quantization offers zero-calibration setup with significant memory savings. For dedicated local document triage servers, INT8 Static Quantization is recommended for highest throughput.
